review_scope: CANDIDATE_REVIEW en sesion distinta de Developer y Deployer. Lecturas AWS solo via aws_guard (candidate_read), una por llamada, sin DENIED. No se ejecuto dry-run de update-environment; el plan se valido por inspeccion.

checks.name: release_tree_equals_reviewed_tree
checks.note: git rev-parse 4ee5fad^{tree} == c25cfa2 == reviewed_tree de review-01.

checks.name: release_sha_on_main
checks.note: origin/main == 4ee5fad tras git fetch; es ancestro-o-igual.

checks.name: publish_run_success_for_release_sha
checks.note: gh run view 39330811012: conclusion success, headSha = release_sha.

checks.name: digests_exist_and_immutable
checks.note: ecr describe-images: ambos digests ACTIVE con tag = release_sha.

checks.name: ecr_scan_high_critical_zero
checks.note: scan COMPLETE y findingSeverityCounts vacio en app y caddy.

checks.name: bundle_reproducible_sha256_match
checks.note: Reconstruccion con build_domain_locked_bundle y digests verificados en ECR: sha256 9bbcbac1... identico. Template y constructor iguales al release (git diff --quiet exit 0).

checks.name: bundle_only_compose_no_build_no_legacy_domain
checks.note: Zip con solo docker-compose.yml; sin build:, sin dominio legado; imagenes por digest.

checks.name: s3_object_checksum_matches_bundle
checks.note: head-object ChecksumSHA256 m7y6wYge... == base64 del sha256 del bundle; ContentLength 4815; FULL_OBJECT.

checks.name: application_version_source_bundle_matches
checks.note: describe-application-versions: SourceBundle = bucket/key del S3 verificado; UNPROCESSED.

checks.name: identity_chain_complete
checks.note: commit -> digests -> bundle -> key -> AV -> label consistente.

checks.name: lkg_is_observed_healthy_version
checks.note: describe-environments: VersionLabel = LKG, Ready/Green/Ok, sin operacion en curso.

checks.name: lkg_application_version_usable
checks.note: AV del LKG existe con SourceBundle, UNPROCESSED.

checks.name: lkg_all_digests_present_in_ecr
checks.note: Digests app y caddy del LKG ACTIVE en ECR.

checks.name: no_secrets_in_bundle_or_evidence
checks.note: Inspeccion estructural: el compose usa referencias a variables, sin valores sensibles literales; la evidencia solo contiene identificadores y hashes.

checks.name: smoke_plan_present
checks.note: smoke_plan con 10 pasos incluida la cadena de identidad y el smoke humano AC-7.

checks.name: cutover_is_version_label_only
checks.note: Un update-environment con --version-label; sin option-settings, template, platform ni tier.

checks.name: plan_commands_in_state_allowlist
checks.note: policies.yaml aws.modes.cutover/rollback permiten @read y elasticbeanstalk update-environment; sin dry-run ejecutado.

checks.name: single_promotion_no_retries
checks.note: Un solo comando de cutover, sin reintentos.

checks.name: rollback_version_only_to_named_lkg_single_attempt
checks.note: Rollback version-only al LKG nombrado, max_attempts 1.

checks.name: no_iam_dns_secrets_migrations_in_plan
checks.note: Clase A; sin IAM, DNS, secretos ni migraciones.

checks.name: outputs_redacted_safe_to_log
checks.note: El plan usa aws_guard y registra solo identificadores y conteos.

checks.name: residue_classification_by_phase
checks.note: blast_radius_and_residues clasifica imagenes, S3 y AV inertes hasta el cutover.

checks.name: functional_failure_does_not_trigger_rollback
checks.note: rollback condicionado a las 7 condiciones de rollback_authorization; un defecto funcional no lo autoriza.

findings.summary: No se ejecuto dry-run de update-environment: el modo candidate_read no lo permite; el plan se valido por inspeccion.

risks: AC-7 (smoke humano en AWS DEV) queda pendiente tras el cutover.
